question: Which Constitution Amendment Act added provisions related to Municipalities in the Indian Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 3**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Constitution Amendment Act that added provisions related to municipalities in the Indian Constitution is the 74th Amendment Act of 1992.
 
• This amendment is also known as the Constitution **(Seventy-fourth Amendment) Act, 1992**. It introduced significant changes and provisions related to urban local governance in India.
 
• **The 74th Amendment Act provided a constitutional framework for the establishment, functioning, and powers of municipalities, which are referred to as "Nagar Palikas" or "Nagar Nigams" in India.**
 
• These provisions aim to empower local self-government bodies and promote decentralization of power and decision-making at the urban level.
